proof_design: Continuous Euler/KKT and stationary integration are conditional on finite positive expected marginal utility and no upper cap; no general continuous-household existence theorem claimed.
Finite asset/income Bellman contraction and all-history verification are proved with genuinely bounded rewards. Every action checked in original exact4-state Huggett and production economies.
Stationary existence by finite-simplex Cesaro subsequence. Explicit m-step minorization proves uniqueness/convergence and residual bounds; flip and wealth-class examples separate claims.
Two-date convex-marginal-utility comparative static has fixed prices/common feasible interval; no universal aggregate-precautionary theorem imported.
Exact finite exchange and production equilibria have Q² uniform and all mass, ownership, goods and asset accounts. Production primitives chosen to generate verified prices.
Price discontinuity counterexamples distinguish no common deterministic rule in restricted2-date grid from failed selection in an infinite-horizon economy with an alternate equilibrium.
Same-domain contraction discretization bound and stationary-law perturbation bound have explicit premises; no mesh diagnostic represented as proof of a uniform bound.
limits: Original proofs and problems; no copied exam, source calibration or assertion that historical article tables were reproduced. PDF skill reused for read-only rendering; no authored PDF artifact.
